# Draft:Saludi Glassware

Saludi Glassware is an American lifestyle glassware company that produces decorative drinkware and sells its products primarily through direct-to-consumer online channels. The company is known for colorful glassware designs and limited-edition collections.
History
Saludi Glassware was established as a lifestyle-focused glassware brand specializing in decorative and gift-oriented drinkware. According to the company, its products are designed for home entertaining and everyday use. Saludi operates primarily through e-commerce and markets its products through online platforms and social media.
Products
Saludi produces a range of drinkware products, including wine glasses, coupe glasses, and cocktail glasses. Its products are frequently released as themed or seasonal collections. A product review published by The Kitchn described Saludi’s colored wine glasses as visually distinctive and suitable for everyday use, noting their balance of design and practicality.
Collaborations
In February 2025, Saludi collaborated with Brooklyn and Bailey McKnight to release a limited-edition glassware collection. The collaboration launched through Saludi’s website and sold out shortly after release. According to regional news coverage, the collection sold out within hours, leading to additional restocks later in 2025 in response to consumer demand.
Business model
Saludi operates as a direct-to-consumer brand, selling products primarily through its official website. The company emphasizes limited production runs and periodic restocks of select designs rather than maintaining a fixed catalog.
Reception
Reception to Saludi’s products has appeared in lifestyle and home-focused publications. The Kitchn reviewed the company’s colored wine glasses, highlighting their design and usability for everyday entertaining. The Fox Magazine described the brand as emphasizing color, craftsmanship, and gift-oriented design within the home decor and entertaining space.
